launch.title: Remove Element: Return the Valid Prefix | InterviewReel
launch.description: Remove a target value in place with read pointer r and write pointer w. This swap-based solution preserves kept order; only the first k values count, and the remaining array slots are ignored. O(n) time, O(1) extra space. Practice target: 1 second for up to 100000 integers. Original deterministic visuals with AI-generated narration.
launch.socialCaption: Removing an element does not mean shrinking the array. Return k and keep the valid prefix. Try [3,3,2], target 3. #DSA #CodingInterview #TwoPointers #InterviewReel
launch.pinnedComment: For nums = [3,3,2] and target = 3, what are k and nums[0..k-1]? Comment both. Tail values do not count.
